sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase feed: a year listing's rows are marked too (e.g. /1973-list). A listing links the show's entry on its year page, not the show's own page; the feed now names the year-page anchor of every show it marks, so the row of 1975-11-10 Tampa gets the same ❌ as the show's row on the year page. Where two entries of a year page share one anchor (1972's two Mediasound sessions), the row's own date picks the show. No request.
On Brucebase, the window of such a link (Ctrl+hover a listing row's Event link, Space) carries the show's marks after its title as well.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Needs the feed of BruceParser 0.20.0 on GitHub; an older feed marks no listing row. A script before this version ignores the new data.
